answer: A newcomer earns standing by crossing dunes, carrying an ivory token and logging a checkpoint at three oases — photo, timestamp, and token stamp at each. A raven carries each receipt to the office the same day. Two caravan masters verify the receipts against the office log within five days, checking stamp and flight time. A forged stamp, missing checkpoint, or receipt slower than a raven can fly voids the season, burns the 60-credit stake, and bars the sponsor a year. One honest crossing costs 60 credits; a thousand fakes need 1,000 stakes and 3,000 forged receipts with matching flights.
